with mij = float j of the 16-byte row i at rdx + 16i, t = m11 + m00 + m22 and N = (t is below 0; comiss, NaN false): P = N and not (m22 > m00 and m22 > m11), Q = N and (m11 > m00 or m22 > m00), U = N and (m22 > m11 or not m11 > m00); negates m22 and m10 when P, m00 and m21 when Q, m11 and m02 when U; S = m11 + m00 + m22 + 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) of those values, h = 0.5 (`01CEBB70`) / `00861F14`(S) (sqrtf); with a = (m12 - m21) h, b = (m20 - m02) h and c = (m01 - m10) h (each first term unnegated) and d = h S, the tuple (a, b, c, d) becomes (d, c, b, a) when P, then has its first two and its last two components swapped when Q; stores it as four floats at `rcx` and returns `rcx`
